title: Source map for the current Deployment implementation
summary: Deployment.cls owns reconciliation/plan gates; DeploymentDependencies.cls owns the portable generic lock; SscDeploymentDependencies.cls is the legacy/development loose-source adapter; SscSealedDeploymentDependencies.cls consumes current SSC sealed deployment/package services; materialize_dependency_namespace.sh and verify_dependency_namespace.sh own POSIX deterministic package namespace mechanics; NativeDeployment and HostedModuleDeployment retain their lifecycle boundaries.
invariants: Read the owning source before modifying a behavior.
Keep generic dependency objects independent from SSC so minimal bootstrap remains non-circular.
Use SscSealedDeploymentDependencies.cls for current qualified release fixed points; keep SscDeploymentDependencies.cls explicitly loose/development.
Put target namespace filesystem mechanics in provider helpers rather than SSC semantic services.
Do not implement a native ABI special case in Audio if it belongs in NativeDeployment.
Do not implement MCP/Wire activation special cases in core when a hosted adapter declaration can express them.

provenance.claim: Maps dev4 dependency namespace and current SSC authority split.
